Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

May 25, 2026

## [I placed an order for wallpaper and…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a14a929c8f53ef2994770d4)
I placed an order for wallpaper and then immediately after I needed to add two more rolls. Customer service didn’t get back to me until days later so now it’s $120 in shipping costs.

May 20, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 26, 2026

Hi Erin,

Thank you for your feedback! I understand how frustrating it can be when you need to adjust an order. Once an order is placed, it is immediately sent to our distribution warehouse, and unfortunately, we are unable to edit or add items at that point. If you have any further questions or need assistance, please let our Customer support team know. We are happy to help!

Lulu and Georgia
